{{Quote|Not for the faint of heart! This zesty slider features a patty topped with mouthwatering Zeltron pop-peppers, pink lettuce, magenta onions and spicy "pleasure planet" sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, regarding the Zeltros slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Pink lettuce''' was a variety of [[Lettuce/Legends|lettuce]] used by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The lettuce was an ingredient in the diner's [[Zeltros slider]], a [[Slider|dish]] inspired by Jettster's travel around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and specifically<ref name="Menu" /> the planet [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="Pleasure Planet">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040105zeltros|text=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|int=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pink lettuce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
